title: ‘Scapegoating’: green groups condemn plan to axe Environment Agency and Natural England
summary_full: Ministers proposing to abolish the quangos in attempt to give politicians more control over what gets built and where Scientists have accused the government of scapegoating nature for proposing to scrap the only environmental regulator with a legal duty to protect the natural world.Louise Haigh, the de facto deputy prime minister, said on Monday that the independent regulator Natural England and the Environment Agency were being reviewed as part of a wider shake-up of quangos, or arm’s length bodies. Ministers are considering abolishing the two biggest environmental regulators in an attempt to give politicians greater control over what gets built and where. Continue reading...
